hits.description: Omnilab STRING: a protein by its STRING id (9606.ENSP00000269305), UniProt accession, Ensembl protein or name - its preferred name, protein name, annotation, species and Ensembl protein - its interaction partners as related things with their combined scores, the network among proteins with each evidence channel's score, and their functional enrichment (GO, KEGG, Reactome, Pfam, InterPro, diseases), through STRING's API, no key needed.

hits.name: omnilab/reactome
hits.description: Omnilab Reactome: a pathway or a reaction by its stable identifier (R-HSA-70171) - its names, species, summary, compartments, GO biological process, Rhea reaction, inputs, outputs and catalysts, review status, release dates, DOI and diagram - its participants (UniProt proteins, ChEBI small molecules), organism, sub-events and orthologous events as related things, a search by text, and the pathways of a protein or a molecule (UniProt, ChEBI), through Reactome's Content Service, no key needed.

hits.name: omnilab/quickgo
hits.description: Omnilab QuickGO: a Gene Ontology term (GO:0005829) - its name, definition, aspect, synonyms, comment, obsolescence, direct parents by relation and children - a UniProt protein with the GO terms it is annotated to by aspect and evidence, its annotations with their evidence, reference and curator, and a search of terms, through the EBI's QuickGO services, no key needed.

hits.name: omnilab/interpro
hits.description: Omnilab InterPro: an InterPro entry (IPR000971) or a Pfam family (PF00042) - its name, type, description, member signatures, GO terms, protein and structure counts, Pfam clan, representative structure, overlapping entries and hierarchy - a UniProt protein with the InterPro entries and Pfam families it matches, by type and position, as related things, and a search of InterPro entries, through the InterPro API, no key needed.
